label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: Variable bar resolves to user input param after a partial regex blacklist filter. The regex removes <script>, onerror, onclick, and javascript:, but does not encode HTML entities or block other XSS vectors (e.g., onmouseover, onload, svg onload, css expressions). The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled and written to the HTML response. Proper mitigation requires HTML entity encoding, not just substring removal.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from request, stored in bar via regex replaceAll, printed to response writer without full HTML encoding.
